title: Shots Fired (TV series)
premise_summary: Shots Fired is an American ten-part drama television miniseries that aired on Fox from March 22 to May 24, 2017. The miniseries depicts a DOJ investigation into a racially-charged police shooting of an unarmed teenager, which leads to the DOJ officials uncovering a potential conspiracy involving the death of another teenager.
